levels.label: Low
levels.description: Little to no heat-related health impacts are expected.

levels.label: Mild
levels.description: Warm day. A minor increase in heat-related health impacts is expected among those sensitive to heat.
levels.guidance: People sensitive to heat should drink extra water and take breaks somewhere cool.

levels.label: Moderate
levels.description: Very warm day. A moderate increase in heat-related health impacts is expected among those sensitive to heat.
levels.guidance: People sensitive to heat should limit time outdoors in the afternoon, drink extra water, and stay somewhere cool during the hottest hours.

levels.label: High
levels.description: Hot day. An increase in heat-related health impacts is expected for everyone, especially those without access to adequate cooling and hydration or those engaged in strenuous physical activity outdoors. This level of heat can pose a significant risk to health.
levels.guidance: Everyone should drink extra water, limit strenuous outdoor activity, and spend the hottest hours somewhere cool.

levels.label: Severe
levels.description: Extreme heat day. A major increase in heat-related health impacts is expected for everyone, especially those without access to adequate cooling and hydration or those engaged in strenuous physical activity outdoors. This level of heat can pose a very serious risk to health.
levels.guidance: Everyone should stay somewhere cool when possible, drink at least 2 glasses of water an hour, and check on people at higher risk.
